title: The Last Courier
premise: Mara delivers packages in a flooded megacity
protagonist_goal: deliver the stolen data core before dawn
stakes: If Mara fails to deliver the stolen data core before dawn, the opposition wins by default. Someone Mara loves loses their freedom. The city's power shifts permanently. The deadline is real: miss it and the job is gone, the identity is rewritten, and the mission dies with Mara's reputation.

beats.name: Opening
beats.change: A door closed permanently. The story can't go backward.
beats.new_problem: the opposition adapts. The next obstacle is harder because of what Mara just did.
beats.cost: The plan worked -- but the price was a piece of Mara's self-image.

beats.name: Escalation
beats.change: Mara's status shifts: what was safe is now dangerous.
beats.new_problem: The solution created a new enemy: someone who was neutral now opposes Mara.
beats.cost: An ally's trust cracks. The relationship shifts.

central_conflict: Mara vs the opposition: a fight over who controls the truth, the resources, and the outcome of deliver the stolen data core before dawn. The deeper conflict is internal: Mara's control issues is the weapon the opposition exploits.
protagonist_need: Learn to overcome control issues by choosing vulnerability over control.
